_comment: Registry of in-article figure templates (docs/figures.md). Read by astro/src/data/figures.ts for rendering and by tools/lib/figures.mjs for validation, so both check the same ids and fields. Invariant: `kinds` lists exactly the kinds some template can produce — a kind without a template is not validatable. Adding a template = an entry here + a component in astro/src/components/figures/ + a branch in DataFigure.astro.

kinds.infographic: Data graphic rendered as HTML from the article's own values. Real text, ja+en.
kinds.schematic: Steps / flow / process diagram rendered as HTML.
kinds.ui: Pseudo-interface (card, ticket, mock UI) rendered as HTML. Real text, ja+en.

planned_kinds.photo: Raster photo, text-free (image model). Needs `src`, a component and a generator step; until then a photo in an article is the `img` block.
planned_kinds.illustration: Raster editorial illustration with a character. Same as photo: covers and `img` today.
planned_kinds.composite: Raster base plus an HTML overlay; any text lives in the overlay. Planned.
